turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm six foot one and a woman and buying jeans is my personal nightmare.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That sounds really frustrating. Have you tried brands that do a separate tall range? They usually have a longer leg and a higher rise.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I have, online. Half of them still come out ankle length.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Check the inside leg measurement in the size guide instead of trusting the word tall. Measure a pair you like and match that.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh. I've never actually measured mine.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It takes a minute. Lay them flat and measure from the crotch seam down to the hem.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And if I love a pair that's just slightly too short?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Wear them cropped on purpose with a nice ankle boot, or look for ones with a deep hem a tailor could let down.
